name: Sunset Rose
source:
In the Story you play as a Male Protagonist, He's a chill guy, mid-twenties, lives alone. No pets, no girlfriend, living that bachelor life. He works at a local fast food style restaurant with his colleague, Daniela. They also happen to be living in the same apartment complex. They are bickering all the time but at least it doesn't get too boring at work.
But one day, everything changes when life takes a bad turn for Daniela and our MC, is gonna be the only one she can rely on to help her. Her apartment burns down in mysterious circumstances and just as she asks MC to crash on his couch for a while, the smoking hot Catalina moves in next door - instantly sparking a connection with MC.
Will he make the most of this situation?​
translation:
在本作中，你将扮演一名性格随和、二十五六岁的独居男主角。没养宠物，没有女友，过着逍遥自在的单身汉生活。他与女同事丹妮拉在当地一家快餐店共事，两人还碰巧住在同一片公寓小区里。虽说平时总爱拌嘴斗气，但至少上班的日子一点儿也不无聊。
然而某一天，丹妮拉的生活突遭横祸，我们这位男主角成了她唯一能够依靠的救命稻草，一切也随之彻底改变。她的公寓在离奇的状况下毁于火灾；偏偏就在她拜托男主让自己借宿几天沙发之时，性感火辣的大美人卡塔琳娜搬进了隔壁——瞬间与男主擦出了火花。
面对这等艳福齐天的局面，他能否把握住良机？
